exposure: Normal-weight infants with parity greater than two
Girls with parity greater than two
cohort: 21,716 children under 18 years of age in Fujian Province
finding: Children born via cesarean section to mothers with a parity greater than two, especially girls and those with normal birth weight, had an increased risk of wheezing.
mod_finding: In cases of parity greater than two, the risk of wheezing in cesarean section deliveries was higher than that in vaginal deliveries.
